items.root_cause: Invoke-CaptureRunPushRetry pushes `HEAD:main`, the whole branch, without asking whether HEAD holds commits a session made after the run's own sha; and the caller then records HEAD as committed_sha on every non-landed outcome, so the bot adopts a session's commits as its own for every later retry and page.

root_fix.what: grocery/capture-run.ps1: the retry lists `HEAD ^<sha> ^origin/main`; any commit there refuses with outcome foreign-commits (no sync, no push). It sets head_owned only after that check passes, and the caller records HEAD as committed_sha only when head_owned; a refusal or already-landed keeps the run's own sha.

root_fix.what: check-skills.py: in_flight_files/split_in_flight give the index-link and dangling-link checks the uncommitted check's own 48 h bar; an UNTRACKED file at or under it is IN FLIGHT and a warning.
